title: Hand-made resources in the running Anthus deployments are imported, not replaced
description:
Design and dry-run only until Ryan has seen each change set. Never create, change or import in the Anthus account without his go-ahead.

```gherkin
Feature: Existing resources join the pipeline in place

  Scenario: A hand-made zone, role or provider is imported
    Given a resource that was made by hand and is in use
    When the pipeline first manages it
    Then the change set shows Import and no Add, Modify or Remove of that resource
    And the resource has DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy Retain
    And for a Route 53 zone the name servers are the same before and after

  Scenario: Nothing is imported until a person has seen the change set
    Given an import of a production resource
    Then the first run stops at the change set for approval
```
